name: Witch's Grasp
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Spirit vs Strength against a creature within short range. On a win, the creature's speed is reduced to 0, and on each of its turns, it may spend an action to roll Strength against your original Spirit roll. No effect on a loss.

If the creature has attacked you or forced you to make an opposed skill check within the last minute and has never been damaged by you, each of its Strength checks are ill-favored.
successes:
✨: On a win, the creature takes HEART damage.

🌞: On a win, the creature takes HEART damage each time it loses an opposed check for this spell.
